scope: Dust2 only, route A small curated knowledge base

confidence_policy.verified: Checked against a real demo and/or in-game; may drive hard rules.
confidence_policy.community: From a public guide or widely used convention; needs a demo check before hard blame.
confidence_policy.draft: Engine bootstrap / expert draft; must not produce definitive blame.
confidence_policy.unknown: Data unavailable; do not make a claim.

known_limits: Zone centers are approximate and must be calibrated against demo positions.
Exact utility lineups are not captured yet; only origin/target zones are described.
A smoke landing in a target zone does not by itself prove that a sightline was blocked.
Demo data does not include voice communication or intent.
Dust2 only; other maps must not be inferred from this file.
